title: mut.manual
mutation_directive: OVERWRITE-DIRECTION evolution from parent p9n. The visual currently reads as a TUFT OF HAIR held in low light — keep that, deepen it. Evolve toward a memorial-hair / mono-no-aware register: Chiharu Shiota hair-strand vocabulary meeting Casey Reas restraint. SPECIFICATIONS: (1) CENTER the tuft in the frame (currently right-of-center). The tuft should occupy ~25% of frame, centered, abundant black around it — the void IS the work. (2) Render filaments as THREE.LineSegments OR thin Line2 with LineBasicMaterial (single near-white #e8e6df, additive blending, alpha 0.4-0.7 per segment). Aim for ~800-1500 visible strands, each gently curved (use a CatmullRomCurve3 with 4-8 control points + slight perturbation per strand). (3) ADD a faint SODIUM-AMBER backlight halo (~30% wider than the tuft, 0.05 alpha #d4a574, additive — feels like backlit hair). (4) ADD a very subtle SUSPENDED-PRESENCE shadow beneath the tuft — a thin dark ellipse at ~0.15 alpha black, hinting the hair hangs from something invisible. (5) MOTION: extremely slow breath cycle, each filament curve perturbed by ±0.3% over 12-second period (barely perceptible). 1-3 strands have BROKEN OFF and drift upward-left at 0.02 units/sec — shedding into memory. (6) INTERACTION: pointer orbit; on click, time-slow to 0.3× (more stillness). (7) PALETTE: cream-on-black with one warm accent (the halo). NO RGB. NO sparkle. Reas restraint preserved. (8) Camera framing must keep the form clearly readable — slow gentle orbit, not whip-pan. CONCEPT: this is a HELD MEMORY. Calm, never agitated. The viewer should feel a small grief.
